### So Help Me, God: The Expectation of Leadership
Author: T. M. Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/church/pastors-or-leadership/so-help-me-god-the-expectation-of-leadership-11606923.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 19:7
Points:
- Public leaders who invoke God must recognize they govern for the Lord, not mere human approval.
- Exercising godly authority requires maintaining an active personal relationship with the Lord through spiritual disciplines.
- Cultivating the fear of God establishes wisdom and prevents leaders from adopting sinful policies.
- Judges and rulers must act carefully, rejecting partiality, bribery, and selfish ambition to mirror God's justice.
- Citizens should actively hold officials accountable to treat their solemn oaths as meaningful commitments.
